summary: Right hemithorax opacification on prior shows partial clearing with faint vessel return on current, while the left hemithorax, clear on prior, now shows new patchy haze at the same rib level; matched using rib and hilar landmarks.

findings.rationale: Prior right hemithorax is a near-complete whiteout with no visible vessels; current shows faint vascular/rib detail returning through the same region, suggesting partial resolution. Dense device/line overlap and differing exposure make this uncertain.

Prior left lung shows clear vascular markings down to the mid zone; current shows new haziness obscuring the same vessels at a comparable rib level, suggesting new consolidation. Overlapping catheters and exposure differences limit confidence.
